Method of Attack: Injecting malicious skimmer scripts into a cloud video player JavaScript file used by real estate sites to steal sensitive information entered into website forms
Skimmer code steals victim names, email addresses, phone numbers, and credit card information and sends it to an attacker-controlled server
Impacted Systems: Over 100 real estate websites embedding the compromised video player
Attack Vector: Compromise of upstream JavaScript file of a cloud video player allowing injection of malicious skimmer code
Embedding of the infected video player on real estate websites
